description: Decode raw EVM calldata into a human-readable function name, canonical signature, and typed parameter values. Resolves the 4-byte selector against openchain.xyz's signature directory, then ABI-decodes the args. Use for tx inspection before signing, mempool analysis, debug. EVM-only (chain='ethereum'); 'solana' returns 400. $0.001 USDC.

calldata_hex.description: Raw EVM calldata (>=4 byte selector), with or without 0x prefix.

contract_address.description: Optional. Reserved for future on-chain ABI lookups.

name: decode_calldata
